description_en: Registers a Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) device with a specified agent in an instance. A SIP device can be a physical SIP phone or a softphone
description_zh: 调用RegisterDevice注册SIP设备到指定实例下的指定坐席， SIP设备可以是SIP话机或SIP软电话
kebab_example: aliyun ccc register-device --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id test-device --password password --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterDevice

parameters.description_en: The custom device ID. No specific format is required.
parameters.description_zh: 设备ID，用户可自行设置，无特殊要求，字符串形式即可。
parameters.help_en: The custom device ID. No specific format is required
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，用户可自行设置，无特殊要求，字符串形式即可
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.description_en: The password used to authenticate the SIP device during registration. Keep this password secure.
parameters.description_zh: 设备密码，该密码用于在SIP设备发起注册信令时做鉴权校验，请妥善保管。
parameters.help_en: The password used to authenticate the SIP device during registration. Keep this password secure
parameters.help_zh: 设备密码，该密码用于在SIP设备发起注册信令时做鉴权校验，请妥善保管
parameters.name: password
